scheme.name: add
scheme.description: Sum the data point and correction value. E.g. y=x+C, where x is the data point and C is the change factor.

scheme.name: scalar
scheme.description: Multiply the data point by a correction factor. E.g. y=Cx where x is the data point and C is the correction factor.

scheme.name: power
scheme.description: Raise data point to power of correction factor. E.g. y=x^C where x is the data point and C is the correction factor.

scheme.name: clip
scheme.description: Clip values above or below threshold to the threshold.

scheme.name: range
scheme.description: Data fell outside of legitimate min and max.

scheme.name: battery_v
scheme.description: The battery voltage was too low to power the sensor properly.

scheme.name: samples
scheme.description: Too few samples were taken by the logger from the sensor within the measuring period.

scheme.name: error_code
scheme.description: The data value is an error code.

scheme.name: flatline
scheme.description: Flat line in the data detected.

scheme.name: linear_interp
scheme.description: Linear interpolation used to infill gap.

scheme.name: alt_data
scheme.description: Alternative data used to infill gap.
